task: Predict estrogen receptor status in breast carcinoma. Classes: ER_Negative vs. ER_Positive. On H&E, ER-positive tumors more often show lower to intermediate grade, tubule formation, and less pleomorphism, whereas ER-negative tumors more often show high grade, solid growth, marked atypia, and brisk mitotic activity.

classes.0: ER-negative breast carcinoma with high-grade morphology, reduced tubule formation, marked nuclear pleomorphism, and frequent mitoses.
classes.1: ER-positive breast carcinoma with more luminal-type morphology, including better gland formation, lower nuclear grade, and less proliferative appearance.
